- the 30 km bubble being small enough that lodging villages (Chanaz, Yenne) double as day-trips
- the time-of-year blockers stack (Faure closed all 2026, Mont Granier May–Nov, Fer à Cheval Apr–Oct) plus the Festival du Cru Jongieux 18–19 July 2026 as the one calendar magnet
- the honest tech-events gap, with DevFest Lyon as the only realistic conference stack

Ends on the unresolved call between literal walking and the chef's shuttle rather than a "in conclusion" sentence.
